name: asset-l10-minigun
note: L10 mounted rotary minigun on its sandbag pivot mount, courier standing 3.4 m behind it for scale. Look for: barrel cluster readable at zoom 0.5, shield plate and sandbags not sunk or floating, courier clear of the mount, LOD swap (low tier) without a silhouette jump. The orange heat sleeves are the heatGlow node, which the runtime shows only while overheating.
